title: fix(runtime): the package disable and DELETE routes announce the withdrawal
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DH9e4qEZ6HPSFPqXCYcdFui)_

Part of #33527 (items 1 and 3; item 2, the two plugin-security comments, stays open because open PRs #33478 and #33473 edit those files).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:停用(`PATCH /packages/:id/disable`)与卸载(`DELETE /packages/:id`)两个接口,在注册表撤下包之后广播 `metadata:reloaded { changed: ['app/ID'] }`,与安装、启用、marketplace 本地卸载同一写法。
- 为什么改:实测停用后,包里的记录触发流程仍绑定在自动化引擎里,每次写记录照样执行,直到重启;卸载后接口返回的瞬间,下一次写记录仍会执行一次。
- 风险与回滚:只是多发一个已有事件,订阅方都是幂等的;广播失败只记一条 warn,不改变接口结果。回滚即还原 `packages.ts` 的两处调用。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 停用接口里的 `wasEnabled` 判断与卸载接口里的 `if (registryRemoved)` 调用;其次是同文件 `announcePackageReload` 的失败文案分支。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-reload-announce.test.ts`,预期 10/10 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `PATCH /packages/:id/disable` announces `metadata:reloaded` with `{ changed: ['app/ID'] }` after `registry.disablePackage`, only when the package was enabled before (read with the registry's own `isPackageDisabled`, which mirrors the enable door's reading). Disabling a package that is already disabled announces nothing.
- `DELETE /packages/:id` announces the same payload after the registry withdrawal, the state-record clear and the verb's cleanups, and only when the running registry actually withdrew the package (`registryRemoved`). This is the order the marketplace install-local uninstall uses ("LAST", and "not when the registry refused"). The announce runs before both answers, `200` and the partial `400`, because the package has left the registry either way.
- Both doors go through `announcePackageReload`, the same seam (`deps.announceKernelEvent`) and failure rule as the install and enable doors: a subscriber failure logs one `warn` and never changes the answer. The warn text names what a withdrawal keeps (flows stay armed) instead of what an install misses.
- Item 3 (N2): the `announcePackageReload` jsdoc now says that an install which lands disabled is announced too, and that this is harmless because subscribers read through the registry's disabled filter. The jsdoc also covers the two withdrawal doors and records the measurement.

Decision record, on the order's axes (correctness first, then smallest change, then effort): the withdrawal goes through the existing helper and the existing event. There is no new event, and no engine-side teardown list. The install-local uninstall comment warns that a second teardown is how the two would drift.

## Probe (item 1), measured on `origin/main` e3f0cfd422

Rig: a real `ObjectKernel` with the SQL driver (better-sqlite3 `:memory:`), `ObjectQLPlugin` (with its built-in protocol), the real `AutomationServicePlugin` and the real `RecordChangeTriggerPlugin`, and an `HttpDispatcher` over the kernel. An authored package is installed through `POST /packages` and declares a dependency on a code package that serves `probe_ticket`. Its flow is saved through `protocol.saveMetaItem({ type: 'flow', packageId })` (publish mode). The flow is `record-after-create` on `probe_ticket`, and a `create_record` node is replaced by a recorder so that a run is observed. The probe was a one-off scratch file and is not committed.

| Step | `origin/main` | This branch |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Before any withdrawal, insert a row | flow runs | flow runs |
| `PATCH /:id/disable` → 200, then insert a row | **flow still runs**; trigger binding still active; `GET /meta/flow` no longer lists it | flow does not run; binding gone |
| (main only) a manual `metadata:reloaded { changed: ['app/ID'] }` after the disable | binding gone, flow does not run | n/a |
| `PATCH /:id/enable` → 200, insert | flow runs again | flow runs again |
| `DELETE /:id` → 200, bindings read right after the answer | **binding still active** | binding gone |
| insert right after the `DELETE` answered | **flow runs once** | flow does not run |
| insert 1 s later | flow does not run (the async metadata-mutation sync of the deleted row withdrew it) | flow does not run |

So the premise holds for both doors. Disable left the package armed until a restart. `DELETE` left a window: the withdrawal rode only on the asynchronous mutation sync of the deleted `sys_metadata` row, after the door had answered. The authored hooks and actions re-sync on the same `metadata:reloaded` subscriber set. This PR fixes them through the same announce, but did not measure them separately.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the shared harness `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-reload-announce.test.ts` (real kernel, real `SecurityPlugin`, real `HttpDispatcher`; the recorder now also records whether each held package was disabled when the announce arrived):

1. A disable of an enabled package announces `app/ID` once, with the package held and already disabled.
2. A disable of a package that is already disabled announces nothing.
3. An uninstall announces `app/ID` once, with the package no longer held.
4. An uninstall of a package the registry does not hold answers 404 and announces nothing.
5. A throwing subscriber: both doors still answer 200, and each failure is logged once at `warn` naming the package.

The three #33302 expectations gained the recorder's new `off` field (`false`). Nothing else in them changed.

Ablation (one-off, not committed). After the fix was committed, `packages.ts` was restored to `e3f0cfd422` in the working tree only. The test subject is imported from `src/`, so no rebuild was needed. The mutation was proven on disk: the blob changed and the `'uninstalled'` anchor count went to 0. Result: **3 failed | 7 passed (10)**. The red cases were 1, 3 and 5. The green ones were the five #33302 cases and the two no-announce cases, which should stay green. Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`, blob equal to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Verification

- `vitest run src/domains/packages-reload-announce.test.ts`: 10 passed (10).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`).
